2026-11-20T05:16Z · **This card now carries a fold group.** Shared mechanism: author-time seed checks in `os validate` / `os build` (validation rules on seed rows, a blank key field). The cards below, unclaimed and unstarted, are closed into this one so a single claimant fixes them in one PR. Each row's source card keeps its full body; this card closes when every row below and its own ask are done. Grade stays the highest of the group.

- [ ] #35486 (p3) Seed authoring: defineSeed / os validate do not flag a keyed-mode record that leaves a key field blank (refused only at load) — read #35486 for its full detail and acceptance.
